items.Wishing Star: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.
items.Dynamax Band: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.
items.Rotom Bike: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that shines reddish-black.
items.Sausages: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

items.Tin of Beans: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.
items.Bread: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.
items.Pasta: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.
items.Mixed Mushrooms: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they’re added to.

items.Brittle Bones: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.
items.Pack of Potatoes: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.
items.Pungent Root: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.
items.Salad Mix: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.
items.Fried Food: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It’s been a while since it was fried, so it’s gotten greasy.
items.Boiled Egg: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.
items.Camping Gear: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

items.Rusted Shield: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.
items.Fossilized Bird: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.
items.Fossilized Fish: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.
items.Fossilized Drake: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.
items.Fossilized Dino: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

items.Max Honey: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.
items.Max Mushrooms: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.
items.Galarica Twig: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.
items.Galarica Cuff: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.
items.Style Card: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.
items.Armor Pass: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.
items.Exp. Charm: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.
items.Armorite Ore: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.
items.Mark Charm: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.
items.Reins of Unity: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.
items.Galarica Wreath: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.
items.Legendary Clue 1: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.
items.Legendary Clue 2: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.
items.Legendary Clue 3: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.
items.Legendary Clue?: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.
items.Crown Pass: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.
items.Wooden Crown: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.
items.Radiant Petal: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.
items.White Mane Hair: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.
items.Black Mane Hair: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.
items.Iceroot Carrot: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.
items.Shaderoot Carrot: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.
items.Dynite Ore: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.
items.Carrot Seeds: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.
items.Ability Patch: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.
items.Linking Cord: Allows a Pokemon whose evolution is usually triggered by trading to evolve
items.Leaden Ball: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.
items.Gigaton Ball: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.
items.Feather Ball: Can be thrown further than a regular Poké Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
items.Wing Ball: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
items.Jet Ball: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
